statements.text: When a supplier is blocked with a hold type of 'Invoices' or 'All', ERPNext will not allow Purchase Orders to be created for the supplier.

components.subject: authenticated_api_caller
components.purpose: Prevent creation of Purchase Orders for suppliers blocked with Invoices or All hold types.

policy.reason: Derived from supplier documentation stating Purchase Orders are blocked if supplier is on hold with Invoices or All hold type.
